title: Former Lockheed/CIA contractor: EG&G scientists in private Utah labs

tellings.quote: 2001, a former Lockheed and CIA contractor went public saying that Loheed is working on UFO technology and that scientists contracted with EG&G were organizing work in private labs in Utah.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 2001 a man who had worked as a contractor for Lockheed, a major American aerospace and weapons company, and for the CIA, the US spy agency, went public. According to Michels, the man said Lockheed was working on UFO technology and that scientists hired through EG&G, a defense contractor, were running the work in private laboratories in Utah. If true, it would mean private companies, not just the government, hold and study such technology.
